name: Little Princess GO!
source:
In the city of Yumeutsutsu, famous for having the largest theme park in Japan, the "Dream Garden", lies Yumeutsutsu Academy. Attending there is our protagonist Sumito, the son of the Dream Garden's manager.

One day, the princess who is said to be a descendant of Snow White, "Mina", transfers to the school. Eventually, Sumito learns of Mina's hidden secret. Thanks to this, their relationship becomes delicate. Nevertheless, Sumito's mother, the manager, has given the two of them an order.

"Let's make a big theme park event "School Festival" a success!"

Joined by the candidate for the next manager, a secretary who supports Sumito, "Ritsuka."
A dancer working at the theme park, "Alice."
And a school nurse and Sumito's tutor, "Momo."

A slapstick school romantic comedy begins!

[Translated and edited from [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1245061]Getchu[/url]]
translation:
在因拥有日本最大的主题公园“梦幻花园”而闻名的梦悦市，坐落着梦悦学园。出席的还有我们的主角住人，他是梦想花园经理的儿子。

有一天，据说是白雪公主的后裔的公主“米娜”转学到了学校。最终，住人得知了米娜隐藏的秘密。正因为如此，他们的关系变得微妙。尽管如此，住人的母亲兼经理还是给两人下达了命令。

“让‘学园祭’大型主题公园活动取得成功吧！”

下一任经理候选人、支持住人的秘书“立香”也加入其中。
在主题公园“爱丽丝”工作的舞者。
还有学校护士兼住人的家庭教师“Momo”。

一场闹剧校园浪漫喜剧开始了！

[翻译和编辑自 [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1245061]Getchu[/url]]
